patches.name: Addon reordering
patches.description: Adds remote-friendly hold-OK reordering to Stremio's installed-addon list.

patches.name: Multi-account
patches.description: Adds an Android TV account chooser with isolated login, library, addons, watch state, names, colors, and PINs.

patches.name: Side-by-side installation
patches.description: Installs the patched app separately as Stremio Morphe instead of replacing official Stremio.
